UTF-16 range conversion versus the public UTF-8 byte contract

findings.defect: The PCM evidence capture allocated PcmCapture with new and deleted it after the capture deadline while the AVFoundation buffer block (retained by the synthesizer) could still fire, and the block wrote samples/sample_rate/buffers while the main thread read them without synchronization: use-after-free plus a data race on the exact path the simulator always takes.
findings.fix: The capture is owned by a shared_ptr held by the block, every mutable field is guarded by a mutex, the abandoned render is stopped, and the main thread reads a locked snapshot.

findings.defect: engine.hpp claimed delegate callbacks may arrive on any thread, but the atomic sink gate only silenced future loads: a non-main delivery that had already loaded the sink could touch the handle concurrently with detach/destroy.
findings.fix: Every delegate delivery is funnelled through deliverOnMain: so the sink is only touched on the owner (main) thread; main-thread deliveries keep their synchronous reentrant behaviour, other-thread deliveries are re-queued to the main queue. Header and Sink comments now state this guarantee.

findings.defect: memory.speak-fails-without-state-change set the allocator to fail the second allocation point, but reader_tts_speak has exactly one, so the case never reached the MEMORY branch and still passed, with an assertion that tolerated OK.
findings.fix: Fail the first point and require MEMORY, no engine call, unchanged state and a reusable request id.

findings.defect: The merged reports took source_sha/run_id/attempt from the driver environment, so the identity the running consumer wrote about itself (and the SIMCTL_CHILD_* forwarding added for it) was never verified on either platform.
findings.fix: Each producer report (macOS installed consumer, both simulator devices, logic suite) is verified with verify_identity/verify_checks/verify_consumer before merging; the logic suite now emits "pending": 0 so the shared checker can validate it directly.

findings.defect: The documented UNAVAILABLE fallback for a machine with no installed voice could never match: it looked for '"error": "voices"' while the example prints '"error":"voices"'.
findings.fix: Match the string the example actually prints.
